title: On merge-models
summary: Tree-ordered weakly sparse models have recently emerged as a robust framework for representing structures in an ``almost sparse'' way, while allowing the structure to be reconstructed through a simple first-order interpretation. A prominent example is given by twin-models, which are bounded twin-width tree-ordered weakly sparse representations of structures with bounded twin-width derived from contraction sequences.
